description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, step 4): appeal the return order (demonstration appeal) with optional reasons (up to 1,000 characters). Atlas attaches a counterargument written in advance and serves a ruling prepared in advance (order upheld; practice copy only; not the decision of any Magistrate instance). The order stays in force during the appeal. One appeal per copy.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
